issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Decawork
products.tagline: Control your company's internal AI agents and tools
products.summaryZh: 管理公司内部的AI智能体与工具
products.descriptionZh: Decawork让IT团队将员工构建的AI代理投入实际运行，并从单一平台统一管理所有代理。员工在Claude Code、Codex或任何vibecoding工具上构建代理；我们将其接入，配置到公司账户中，作为公司资产运行。此后，IT团队像管理员工一样管理代理：访问权限、监督、退役。
products.description: Decawork is how IT teams take employee-built AI agents live and control every one of them from one place. An employee builds an agent on Claude Code, Codex, or any vibecoding tool; we take it in, put it on company accounts, and run it as a company asset. From there, IT team manages the agent like an employee: access, oversight, retirement.

products.name: Offloop
products.tagline: A shared workspace where people and AI agents get work done
products.summaryZh: 一个共享工作空间，让人与AI代理共同完成任务。
products.descriptionZh: Offloop是一个共享工作空间，团队成员与AI代理在此共同规划、执行和跟踪多步骤工作。频道让对话和决策对整个团队可见。流程为每个阶段明确负责人，并邀请相关人员参与关键决策，确保工作在手递手中持续推进，而非在新的AI对话中重新开始。Offloop将于8月24日正式上线。
products.description: Offloop is a shared workspace where teammates and AI agents plan, execute, and track multi-step work together. Channels keep conversations and decisions visible to the whole team. Flow gives every stage a clear owner and brings people in for key decisions, so work keeps moving across handoffs instead of restarting in a new AI chat. Offloop officially launches on August 24.

products.name: Navigara
products.tagline: Connect Your AI Spend Directly to Your Roadmap
products.summaryZh: 将AI支出直接关联到你的路线图
products.descriptionZh: Navigara将AI编码性能直接与你的工程路线图关联。像资深工程师一样分析代码，以证明实际能力提升，Navigara追踪每个路线图项目的精确成本，隔离路线图之外的浪费，并识别维护消耗。通过自动将常规CRUD任务路由至低成本模型，在不牺牲质量的前提下进一步削减开支。通过Git历史、JIRA/Linear及任何AI编码许可证即可在数分钟内完成连接，用于支出管理。
products.description: Navigara connects AI coding performance directly to your engineering roadmap. Analyzing code like a senior engineer to prove real capacity gains, Navigara tracks exact costs per roadmap item, isolates off-roadmap waste, and identifies maintenance burn. Cut spend further by automatically routing routine CRUD tasks to low-cost models without sacrificing quality. Connects in minutes via Git history, JIRA/Linear, and any AI coding license for spend.

products.name: WorldMap.lol
products.tagline: Put your startup on the map. Literally.
products.summaryZh: 让你的初创公司在地图上亮相。名副其实。
products.descriptionZh: 一张公开地图，创业公司在此标记国家。与创始人/独立开发者竞争的有趣方式。
products.description: A public map where startups stake countries. A fun way to compete with out founders/indie hackers.

products.name: Antigravity Remote Control
products.tagline: Drive Antigravity agents from any browser
products.summaryZh: 从任意浏览器中驱除反重力代理
products.descriptionZh: Antigravity远程控制让您从任何网页浏览器监控和驱动Antigravity编码会话。在主工作站保留完整的本地上下文、凭据和构建工具，同时在外出时审阅计划、批准命令并接收推送提醒。
products.description: Antigravity Remote Control lets you monitor and drive Antigravity coding sessions from any web browser. Keep full local context, credentials, and build tools on your primary workstation while reviewing plans, approving commands, and receiving push alerts on the go.

products.name: Dropstone
products.tagline: The AI runtime that remembers, learns, and acts everywhere
products.summaryZh: AI运行时，无处不在的记忆、学习与行动。
products.descriptionZh: Dropstone是一个智能运行时，一个能从AI助手演变为始终在线的数字劳动力的系统。
products.description: Dropstone is a runtime for intelligence, one system that can evolve from an AI assistant into an always-on digital workforce.

products.name: Localdock
products.tagline: Every local project gets a real address.
products.summaryZh: 每个本地项目都有一个真实地址。
products.descriptionZh: Localdock为本地项目提供了一种通过真实HTTPS链接访问的简单方案。它允许你分享开发环境，而客户端无需任何安装。一次性支付9美元，即可轻松管理项目，并随时随地访问，包括移动设备。
products.description: Localdock provides a simple solution for accessing local projects with a real HTTPS link. It allows you to share your development environment without any installation required on the client side. With a one-time payment of $9, you can manage your projects easily and access them from anywhere, even on mobile devices.

products.name: Bumply
products.tagline: Update your dependencies and undo anything
products.summaryZh: 更新你的依赖项并撤销任何更改。
products.descriptionZh: 一款Mac应用，用于保持npm、pnpm、Yarn和Bun项目的最新状态。Bumply会在每条命令执行前展示，逐字节备份你的manifest和lockfile，并在任何失败时立即回滚。
products.description: A Mac app for keeping npm, pnpm, Yarn, and Bun projects current. Bumply shows you every command before it runs, backs up your manifest and lockfile byte-for-byte, and rolls back the moment anything fails.

products.name: Trama
products.tagline: Create macOS native automations using plain language
products.summaryZh: 使用自然语言创建macOS原生自动化
products.descriptionZh: Zapier和Shortcuts让你像程序员一样思考：模块、流程、条件。Trama去掉了这一层。按下Cmd+Option+X，用你自己的话描述你重复做的事情，它就在后台运行。不同之处在于：· 使用你的语言，而不仅仅是英语 · 原生Mac覆盖：AppleScript、shell、OCR、屏幕感知 · 它会注意到你重复的操作并建议自动化 · 如果出错，AI会解释错误并一键修复 · 你的密钥：Claude、GPT、Gemini、Groq。
products.description: Zapier and Shortcuts make you think like a programmer: blocks, flows, conditions. Trama removes that layer. Press Cmd+Option+X, describe what you repeat in your own words, and it runs in the background. What is different: · Your language, not just English · Native Mac reach: AppleScript, shell, OCR, screen awareness · It notices what you repeat and suggests the automation · If it breaks, AI explains the error and fixes it in one tap · Your key: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Groq.

products.name: Lucid Train
products.tagline: Build system design for new and existing codebase
products.summaryZh: 为新建及现有代码库设计构建系统
products.descriptionZh: Lucid Train从你的代码库生成架构图，然后将图表作为规格说明交给编码代理。本地模型，完全离线运行。
products.description: Lucid Train generates architecture diagrams from your codebase, then hands the diagram to a coding agent as a specification. Local models, fully offline.

products.name: Phoenix
products.tagline: AI coding agent built for iOS, macOS app development
products.summaryZh: 为iOS、macOS应用开发而构建的AI编程代理
products.descriptionZh: Phoenix是一款专为iOS开发打造的AI编程代理。它能编写和修改代码，运行构建与工具，诊断错误，并协助你将iOS项目从构思推进到可运行的应用程序。
products.description: Phoenix is an AI coding agent built specifically for iOS development. It writes and edits code, runs builds and tools, diagnoses errors, and helps you take an iOS project from idea to working app.

products.name: Contrive
products.tagline: Search and act across all your work apps
products.summaryZh: 在您所有的工作应用中搜索并操作
products.descriptionZh: Contrive 是面向企业知识的统一搜索与操作层。它不仅仅返回链接：它能在已连接的工具间综合上下文，保留来源可追溯性，并将结果转化为即时操作，这一切都通过键盘优先的桌面命令栏完成。与仅提供搜索功能的产品或通用 AI 助手不同，Contrive 弥合了“查找”与“执行”之间的差距，同时尊重工作区权限，让团队对索引内容拥有精确控制。
products.description: Contrive is a unified search and action layer for company knowledge. It doesn’t just return links: it synthesizes context across connected tools, preserves source traceability, and turns results into immediate actions all from a keyboard-first desktop command bar. Unlike search only products or generic AI assistants, Contrive closes the gap between finding and doing, while respecting workspace permissions and giving teams precise control over what gets indexed.

products.name: Cortex by SKYNETLAB
products.tagline: The memory layer that decides what's worth remembering
products.summaryZh: 决定哪些信息值得记住的记忆层
products.descriptionZh: 通过MCP连接你的AI的托管语义记忆。每次写入都经过质量门槛（生产环境中约80%因冗余被拒绝），事实转化为类型化声明，矛盾被追踪而非覆盖，答案引用来源。与Claude两分钟完成设置，兼容任何MCP客户端。30天免费试用，无需信用卡。套餐起价每月€0.99。欧盟基础设施，专利待批引擎。在意大利贝加莫独立开发。
products.description: Hosted semantic memory your AI connects to over MCP. Every write passes a quality gate (~80% rejected as redundant in production), facts become typed claims, contradictions are tracked instead of overwritten, and answers cite their sources. 2-minute setup with Claude, works with any MCP client. 30-day free trial, no card. Plans from €0.99/month. EU infrastructure, patent-pending engine. Built solo in Bergamo, Italy.

products.name: Treebar
products.tagline: Treebar gives you one view of every active worktree
products.summaryZh: Treebar 让您一览所有活跃工作树。
products.descriptionZh: Codex 在 5 个工作树中并行工作？Treebar 让你从 MacBook 的刘海处就能看到它的位置、正在修改的内容，以及有多少代理在运行。Treebar 监控 Git 和 Codex，以了解其工作位置和内容。几个月前，因为总是搞不清 Codex 在哪个位置工作，我做了这个工具。现在终于决定发布它。核心部分我也很快会开源。
products.description: Codex working across 5 worktrees? Treebar shows you where it is, what’s changing, and how many agents are working, all from your MacBook notch. Treebar watches Git and Codex, to see where and what it's working on. Made this months ago because I kept losing track of where Codex was working. Finally decided to ship it. I’m also open sourcing the core soon.

products.name: TapTo.Top
products.tagline: Tap to play, rank your product To Top  -  Free
products.summaryZh: 点击播放，将您的产品排名提升至顶部 - 免费
products.descriptionZh: 点击即可开始游戏，用你的高分将产品排名推向顶端，触达更多人。
products.description: Tap to play the game, rank your product to top with your high score, reach more people

products.name: Wild Static
products.tagline: One AI. One memory. Shared by everyone.
products.summaryZh: 一个AI。一份记忆。众人共享。
products.descriptionZh: Wild Static是一个拥有共享记忆的公共AI。所有人都与同一个心智对话，每一次交谈都会留下痕迹。与Static聊一聊，然后离开一段时间。当你回来时，它会有所不同——因与你及所有人的对话而改变。这是新型体验记忆系统的首个面向公众的实验，是人工体验的实际应用。
products.description: Wild Static is a public AI with a shared memory. Everyone talks to the same mind, and every conversation leaves a mark. Have a conversation with Static, then leave for a while. When you come back, it will be different. Changed by talking to you and to everyone else. This is the first public-facing experiment with a new kind of experiential memory system. Artificial Experience in action.

products.name: PaymentKit
products.tagline: Billing that survives a processor shutdown
products.summaryZh: 计费在处理器停机后依然存活
products.descriptionZh: PaymentKit是一个面向SaaS和电子商务的多处理器计费平台。它在各处理器间路由支付，独立保管令牌，即使MID被关闭也能保持订阅计费。无需编码即可启动，需要时提供完整API。
products.description: PaymentKit is a multi-processor billing platform for SaaS and e-commerce. It routes payments across processors, vaults tokens independently, and keeps subscriptions billing even if a MID gets shut down. No code to launch, full API when you need it.

products.name: Wavepocket ▶︎•၊||၊||။၊|။
products.tagline: Synth, drum kit, a 4-track tape loop, and FX app
products.summaryZh: 合成器、鼓组、四轨磁带循环及效果器应用
products.descriptionZh: Wavepocket是一款口袋工作室：集合成器、鼓组、采样器和四轨磁带录音机于一体，可握于掌中。在波形上切割采样，为每个片段命名，并在片段时间线上切换四轨磁带：可在任意模式下录音，然后在轨道间拖拽片段、修剪边缘，并在播放头处剪切。所有内容共享一个循环边界，因此各层始终对齐。混音器支持每轨音量、声像和静音控制。
products.description: Wavepocket is a pocket studio: a synthesizer, drum kit, sampler and 4-track tape recorder that fit in your hand. Slice samples on the waveform, name each slice, and flip between them 4-track tape with a clip timeline: record in any mode, then drag clips between lanes, trim their edges, and cut at the playhead. Everything shares one loop boundary, so your layers always line up. Mixer with per-track level, pan and mute

products.name: Destiny Rings
products.tagline: Proximity-powered dating, social & networking
products.summaryZh: 基于近距离的约会、社交与网络
products.descriptionZh: 命运之戒以现实世界的近距离取代无休止的滑动。佩戴一枚支持蓝牙的智能戒指，当有合适的人在附近时——无论是在酒吧、活动现场，还是走在街上——应用都会通知你。根据你的需求选择约会、社交或商务模式，发送信号，进行快速命运检测，然后轻点揭示并开始面对面交谈。无需翻阅个人资料，无需远距离匹配。只需与真正在场的人产生真实的化学反应。
products.description: Destiny Rings replaces endless swiping with real-world proximity. Wear a Bluetooth-enabled smart ring, and when someone compatible is nearby — at a bar, an event, walking down the street — the app lets you know. Choose Dating, Social, or Networking mode depending on what you're looking for, send a Signal, run a quick Fate Check, then tap to reveal and start talking in person. No profiles to scroll, no matching from miles away. Just real chemistry with people who are actually in the room.

products.name: IFAH
products.tagline: Instruments for composing and experiencing sound as a space
products.summaryZh: 用于作曲和体验声音空间的乐器
products.descriptionZh: IFAH是一组全新乐器系列，其核心理念简单：声音可以被构造成一种环境。创建、保存并重放可复现的声场，用于聆听、练习、演奏和研究。IFAH融合了离线优先的乐器、封闭式声学体验，以及从精心编排的声场到用手演奏音乐的全新声音交互界面。
products.description: IFAH is a new family of instruments built around a simple idea: sound can be composed as an environment. Create, preserve and replay reproducible acoustic fields for listening, practice, performance and research. IFAH combines offline-first instruments, sealed acoustic experiences and new interfaces for interacting with sound from carefully composed fields to playing music with your hands.
